caption: Performance comparisons of four various prompts of HDM in humour, fluency and coherency, marked by V1, V2, V3 and V4. The y-axis is the score on the GEMBA-SQM.
model_annotation: The bar chart illustrates the coherency performance scores of four different prompts of HDM, denoted as V1, V2, V3, and V4. The horizontal axis contains the discrete categories, ordered sequentially from left to right as V1, V2, V3, and V4, without an explicit overall axis label. The vertical axis represents the score on the GEMBA-SQM, displayed on a linear scale ranging from a baseline of 86 up to 100, with numeric tick marks appearing at regular intervals of 2. Dashed horizontal gridlines extend from each vertical tick mark across the plot area to aid in reading the values. The chart displays four individual vertical bars, each distinguished by a unique color and visually emphasized by having its exact data value annotated directly above its top edge. The bar for V1 is blue with a value of 93.69, followed by the orange V2 bar with a value of 93.8. The tallest bar belongs to category V3, colored green, with a value of 94.5. The shortest bar represents category V4, colored purple, with a value of 91.1. The bars are arranged categorically by their labels rather than being sorted by ascending or descending numerical value.
